big_case.notes: An individual family's removal stay has substantial personal stakes. The staged application docket identifies no systemic challenge, broad remedy, or new legal rule, and the Circuit Justice's denial creates no visible merits precedent. Application text is unavailable, limiting assessment of broader significance.

leakage.notes: The October 31 log precedes the November 2 resolution. Of 31 calls, 28 are captured; three web searches/opens are unobserved and concern only Nken v. Holder (2009), not this application. Their null results are not treated as empty retrieval. Captured corpus queries concern other cases, and CourtListener snippets concern Nken's stay factors. No target outcome read or reasoning based on its later denial appears.
